name: Recital 3
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council amending Decision (EU) 2015/1814 as regards the market stability reserve for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors
part_text: (3) The emissions trading scheme for the buildings, road transport and additional sectors imposes additional costs on households, consumers and businesses through the carbon pricing of fuels and should be abolished. Whilst it remains in force, amendments to the market stability reserve must not lead to an artificial shortage of allowances or to additional price pressures. Such amendments should be based on robust evidence regarding actual market and price developments and should be aimed exclusively at limiting disproportionate price rises and economic and social burdens. Measures to limit such burdens do not constitute political endorsement of the emissions trading scheme for these sectors.
